main_measure.name: OLS slope of drift-adjusted 20-bar short gain on |forecast|
main_measure.threshold: slope > 0 with t >= 2 confirms (with top-fifth check); slope < 0 with t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: mean drift-adjusted short gain of the top fifth of |forecast|

decided_by: The slope's t is between -2 and 2.
reading: Cases are grid positions 0, 20, 40, ... of each window with a 20-bar forward close in the same window, all kept including |forecast| 0, drift is each coin's mean 20-bar grid return over all its windows, and the top fifth is the floor(n/5) pooled cases with the largest |forecast|.
